name: com.langonrock/langonrock
title: Lang on Rock
description: A document database for agent knowledge, served over stdio: six tools by default, four to read and two that commit, plus transact, history and restore with --database-tools.

com.langonrock/deployment.note: This server is run locally by the operator against their own store; langonrock.com hosts the documentation, not an MCP endpoint. It has no remote transport, so the `remotes` array is absent rather than empty.
